1: // Minimal Neon Escape game based on IDEA.md
2: (function(){
3: const canvas=document.getElementById('game');
4:    if(!canvas){console.error('Canvas #game not found');return;}
5:    const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
6:    // audio setup
7:    const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
8:    function playTone(freq, duration){
9:      const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
10:      const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
11:      osc.type = 'sine';
12:      osc.frequency.value = freq;
13:      osc.connect(gain);
14:      gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
15:      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, audioCtx.currentTime);
16:      gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
17:      gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
18:      osc.start();
19:      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
20:    }
21:    const playDash = ()=> playTone(600, 0.1);
22:    const playCrash = ()=> playTone(150, 0.3);
23:    const resize=()=>{canvas.width=window.innerWidth;canvas.height=window.innerHeight;colW=canvas.width/COLS;};
24:    window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
25:    resize();
26:   const COLS=7, ROW_H=30, ORB_R=12;
27:   let colW, speed=2, tick=0, gameOver=false;
28:   let orbCol=Math.floor(COLS/2);
29:   const obstacles=[]; // {y, cells:[{floor, spike}]}
30:   function spawnRow(){
31:     const cells=[];
32:     for(let i=0;i<COLS;i++){
33:       const floor=Math.random()>0.2; // 80% floor
34:       const spike=floor && Math.random()<0.1; // 10% of floors are spikes
35:       cells.push({floor, spike});
36:     }
37:     obstacles.push({y:-ROW_H, cells});
38:   }
39:   function update(){
40:     if(gameOver) return;
41:     tick+=speed;
42:     // move obstacles
43:     for(const o of obstacles) o.y+=speed;
44:     // remove offscreen
45:     while(obstacles.length && obstacles[0].y>canvas.height) obstacles.shift();
46:     // spawn new row at interval
47:     if(tick%ROW_H===0) spawnRow();
48:     // collision check when obstacle reaches orb line
49:     for(const o of obstacles){
50:       if(o.y+ROW_H>canvas.height-ROW_H && o.y<canvas.height-ROW_H){
51:         const cell=o.cells[orbCol];
52:         if(!cell.floor||cell.spike){
53:           gameOver=true;
54:           playCrash();
55:         }
56:       }
57:     }
58:     draw();
59:     if(!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(update);
60:     else drawGameOver();
61:   }
62:   function draw(){
63:     // background gradient
64:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,canvas.height);
65:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0,"#00101a");
66:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1,"#000215");
67:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
68:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
69:     // neon grid
70:     ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,255,255,0.15)";
71:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
72:     ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(0,255,255,0.7)";
73:     ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
74:     for(let i=0;i<=COLS;i++){
75:       ctx.beginPath();
76:       ctx.moveTo(i*colW,0);
77:       ctx.lineTo(i*colW,canvas.height);
78:       ctx.stroke();
79:     }
80:     for(let y=0;y<canvas.height;y+=ROW_H){
81:       ctx.beginPath();
82:       ctx.moveTo(0,y);
83:       ctx.lineTo(canvas.width,y);
84:       ctx.stroke();
85:     }
86:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0; // reset for obstacles
87:     // draw obstacles with neon outline
88:     for(const o of obstacles){
89:       for(let i=0;i<COLS;i++){
90:         const cell=o.cells[i];
91:         if(cell.floor){
92:           // floor block
93:           ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,20,0.6)';
94:           ctx.fillRect(i*colW,o.y,colW,ROW_H);
95:           ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,200,255,0.4)';
96:           ctx.strokeRect(i*colW,o.y,colW,ROW_H);
97:           if(cell.spike){
98:             // glowing spike
99:             const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,o.y,0,o.y+ROW_H);
100:             grad.addColorStop(0,"#0ff");
101:             grad.addColorStop(1,"#00f");
102:             ctx.fillStyle = grad;
103:             ctx.beginPath();
104:             ctx.moveTo(i*colW+colW/2, o.y+ROW_H/2-8);
105:             ctx.lineTo(i*colW+colW/2-8, o.y+ROW_H/2+8);
106:             ctx.lineTo(i*colW+colW/2+8, o.y+ROW_H/2+8);
107:             ctx.closePath();
108:             ctx.fill();
109:             // spike outline glow
110:             ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,255,255,0.8)';
111:             ctx.lineWidth=2;
112:             ctx.stroke();
113:             ctx.lineWidth=1;
114:           }
115:         }
116:       }
117:     }
118:     // draw orb with radial glow
119:     const orbX = orbCol*colW+colW/2;
120:     const orbY = canvas.height-ROW_H/2;
121:     const gradOrb = ctx.createRadialGradient(orbX, orbY, ORB_R/2, orbX, orbY, ORB_R*2);
122:     gradOrb.addColorStop(0,"#0ff");
123:     gradOrb.addColorStop(1,"rgba(0,0,255,0)");
124:     ctx.fillStyle = gradOrb;
125:     ctx.shadowColor = "#0ff";
126:     ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
127:     ctx.beginPath();
128:     ctx.arc(orbX, orbY, ORB_R,0,2*Math.PI);
129:     ctx.fill();
130:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
131:   }
132:   function drawGameOver(){
133:     ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
134:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
135:     ctx.fillStyle='white';
136:     ctx.font='48px sans-serif';
137:     ctx.textAlign='center';
138:     ctx.fillText('Game Over',canvas.width/2,canvas.height/2);
139:   }
140:   canvas.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(gameOver) return; if(audioCtx.state==='suspended'){audioCtx.resume();} const half=canvas.width/2; if(e.clientX<half){orbCol=Math.max(0,orbCol-1); playDash();} else {orbCol=Math.min(COLS-1,orbCol+1); playDash();}});
141:   spawnRow();
142:   requestAnimationFrame(update);
143: })();
